nodes.text: Why don't you come over to my place... Here, the address is...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks for coming...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So... I'm going to teach you a move that `I` was planning to bust out against Paula.
nodes.text_bbcode: So... I'm going to teach you a move that [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] was planning to bust out against Paula.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course, I can't exactly demonstrate it with my leg and all...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But let me describe it...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Okay... I think i've got it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Cool! Let's give it a shot!
Taylor turns on some music.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I... I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: What a pathetic excuse for a guy...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Go get my purse. We're leaving.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: But I don't want to carry your purse.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: It makes me look like a wimp!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: It wasn't a question... `It was an order!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It wasn't a question... [color=#3b78e2][i]It was an order![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Poor guy... Won't he ever stand up to her?
Later...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: First, let's hear it for Paula.

nodes.speaker: Audience
nodes.text: Clap, Clap...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Now let's hear it for $Emily!

nodes.speaker: Audience
nodes.text: WOO HOO!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: That seals it... $Emily is the winner!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: This... This can't be happening!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Andy! Get out here! This is your fault!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You did good out there today, $Emily...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I mean, don't get me wrong, I wish it was me wearing the Homecoming crown.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But for today, enjoy your victory...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It'll be interesting to see what happens when the competition for `Prom Queen` starts!
nodes.text_bbcode: It'll be interesting to see what happens when the competition for [color=#3b78e2][i]Prom Queen[/i][/color] starts!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: No... No it isn't.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: $Emily was just the more deserving candidate.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: WHAT?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: That's it! I'm... I'm reducing your makeout time to `two` minutes a week!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's it! I'm... I'm reducing your makeout time to [color=#3b78e2][i]two[/i][/color] minutes a week!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: You can reduce it to zero for all I care.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: It's over.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Come... Come back here!
Paula races after Andy...
But she trips and falls!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: My... My leg!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Well... I guess justice was served.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Now it's Paula with the broken leg...

nodes.text: First, let's hear it for Paula.

nodes.speaker: Audience

nodes.text: Now let's hear it for $Emily!

nodes.speaker: Audience
nodes.text: Clap, Clap...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Oh my... It sounds like we have a tie!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: It's called a tie... As in, neither of you is the winner.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Sorry, kids... Looks like there's no queen this year!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: But... But no!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: This is even worse than losing...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I just feel so... Mediocre!
This is no way for things to end!
Clearly, you've got some work to do!
So try again... Get those votes, practice those dance moves...
And next time, `beat Paula!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And next time, [b]beat Paula![/b]

nodes.text: Later...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Congratulations, $Emily!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'm so glad you beat Paula...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: And I'm so glad I've gotten to know you... Even if it wasn't for the best reasons at first.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I guess I don't really know you at all...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: But I'm willing to start over now... To get to know you.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'd like that.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: For now, though... Let's dance!
And so Homecoming comes to an end...
You've played a great game and won a happy ending for $Emily and Jacob.

Later...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Man, if someone told me at the beginning of this week that I'd be dating the `Homecoming Queen`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Man, if someone told me at the beginning of this week that I'd be dating the [color=#e23b3b][i]Homecoming Queen[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: ...I would have told them they were crazy.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I guess life doesn't always turn out the way you plan it...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Not at all...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: But the surprises are part of what makes life so fun.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: And you're my favorite surprise yet!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hehe. I'm `surprised` that you're suddenly such a smooth talker!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hehe. I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]surprised[/i][/color] that you're suddenly such a smooth talker!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I'm just teasing...

nodes.text: Now come here...
Kenji gives $Emily a passionate kiss.

nodes.text: I can't believe I'm officially dating the `Homecoming Queen`!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe I'm officially dating the [color=#e23b3b][i]Homecoming Queen[/i][/color]!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: My crew is going to flip when they hear about this.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: But... Anyway. You want to sneak off somewhere and make-out?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I guess this is part of the cost of winning...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Okay... But just for five minutes okay?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: That's four minutes longer than I was counting on!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Let's go!

nodes.text: But at what cost!

nodes.text: Well... Here I am... Homecoming Queen...

nodes.text: So why do I feel so alone?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I mean... Why should I feel bad just because I don't have a date now, right?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I mean, I'd rather be alone than together with someone I don't really like!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: But still...
And so homecoming comes to an end... Just not an ideal end.
You came so close to playing a perfect game...
You just kind of dropped the ball in the boy category.
